topics.title: 课程作业与明确授权
topics.summary: 莱斯大学学生FAQ明确规定，生成式AI仅在主讲教师明确允许时方可用于课业；具体权限因课程大纲与作业要求而异。
topics.scope: 所有本科与研究生课程作业
topics.evidenceScope: Undergraduate and graduate coursework and assignments

claims.text: Student guidance states that AI tools like ChatGPT, Grammarly, or image generators are only permitted if the instructor explicitly allows them for that course.

evidence.quote: Use of AI tools like ChatGPT, Grammarly, or image generators is only allowed if your instructor explicitly says so
evidence.title: Guidelines & Resources for Students | Responsible AI @ Rice
evidence.location: FAQs: For Students, Q: What is Rice’s policy on using AI tools for coursework?

topics.title: 考试考核与荣誉法庭效力
topics.summary: 荣誉法庭通用AI政策统领学术考核，但教授在课程大纲中设立的专属规则优先于法庭通用政策。
topics.scope: 课程期中期末考试、测验与考核
topics.evidenceScope: Course examinations, quizzes, and formal assessments

claims.text: The Rice Honor Council General AI Policy establishes that course-specific AI policies established by professors supersede general Honor Council guidelines for assessments.

evidence.quote: any course-specific AI policy supersedes the Honor Council’s general AI policy.
evidence.title: The Rice Honor Council’s General AI Policy
evidence.location: The Rice Honor Council’s General AI Policy, main text

topics.title: 大纲声明与规范引用
topics.summary: 教务长指导意见敦促教师在教学大纲中明确AI立场，CTE建议学生披露AI协助并规范标引工具。
topics.scope: 课业论文、书面报告与课堂展示

claims.text: Provost faculty guidance urges instructors to outline their stance on AI usage in course syllabi to foster transparency and manage student expectations.

evidence.quote: we urge you to include a section in your syllabus outlining your stance on AI usage in your course
evidence.title: Faculty Guidance on Generative AI | Office of the Provost
evidence.location: Inclusion in Your Course Syllabus, recommendation 1

topics.title: Policy 808数据保护规范
topics.summary: TSS指引建议受Policy 808约束的敏感或机密信息不宜使用消费级或公共AI服务；涉及HIPAA数据须事先咨询信息安全办公室（ISO）。
topics.scope: 学生档案、Policy 808机密数据与大学信息
topics.evidenceScope: Student records, Policy 808 data, and university information

claims.text: TSS guidelines advise that information considered sensitive or confidential by University Policy 808 should not be used with consumer-focused or publicly available AI services, and HIPAA data requires prior consultation with ISO.

evidence.quote: Information considered sensitive or confidential by University Policy 808 (https://policy.rice.edu/808), including private information about individuals and protected research data, should not be used with consumer-focused or publicly available AI services
evidence.title: Technology Solutions & Services: AI Usage Guidelines
evidence.location: Security and Privacy Considerations, Policy 808 restriction

evidence.quote: However, the use of HIPAA data requires prior consultation with ISO.
evidence.title: Technology Solutions & Services: AI Usage Guidelines

topics.title: TSS人工智能服务矩阵
topics.summary: 保留的TSS服务矩阵摘录列出Google Gemini Basic；该摘录未确立现行资格或条款。
topics.scope: 校园企业协议工具与软件采购目录
topics.evidenceScope: Campus enterprise agreements and software catalog

claims.text: The retained TSS matrix excerpt names Google Gemini Basic.

evidence.title: Technology Solutions & Services: AI Usage Guidelines
evidence.location: Service Matrix, Google Gemini Basic row

topics.title: 学术研究合规与数据管护
topics.summary: 负责任AI指引要求在学术研究中使用AI工具必须遵守莱斯大学AI使用指引以及具体工具的支持文档。
topics.scope: 学术研究成果、资助项目与科研数据集
topics.evidenceScope: Scholarly publications, sponsored research, and datasets

claims.text: Responsible AI guidance for faculty and staff specifies that tool usage must follow Rice's AI Usage Guidelines and tool-specific support documentation.

evidence.quote: Use must follow Rice’s AI Usage Guidelines and tool-specific support documentation
evidence.title: Guidelines & Resources for Faculty & Staff | Responsible AI @ Rice

additionalTopics.title: 荣誉裁决与申诉程序
additionalTopics.summary: 研究生荣誉委员会程序下，被认定违规的研究生可在收到通知后30个日历日内申诉。
additionalTopics.scope: 研究生荣誉委员会学术不端裁决申诉时限
additionalTopics.evidenceScope: Graduate Honor Council misconduct appeal filing timeline

claims.text: Under Graduate Honor Council procedures, students found in violation may appeal within 30 calendar days of notice.

evidence.quote: within 30 calendar days of the notice to the student that they were found in violation
evidence.title: Procedures for Reporting and Adjudication | Graduate Honor Council

additionalTopics.title: 教学采纳模式与伦理指引
additionalTopics.summary: 鼓励教师制定学科专项指引，在大纲中载明明确预期，并全面考量AI对教学公平性与培养成效的影响。
additionalTopics.scope: 教学大纲设计与课程方案制定
additionalTopics.evidenceScope: Syllabus policies and course curriculum design

claims.text: Faculty guidance encourages instructors to develop discipline-specific guidelines, set clear expectations in syllabi, and consider AI impacts on fairness and outcomes.

evidence.quote: Faculty are encouraged to develop discipline-specific guidelines, include clear expectations in syllabi, and consider the impact of AI use on fairness and learning outcomes
evidence.title: Guidelines & Resources for Faculty & Staff | Responsible AI @ Rice
evidence.location: FAQs: For Faculty & Staff, syllabus expectations

additionalTopics.summary: TSS指引要求在许可新服务（包括生成式AI服务）前联系信息安全办公室。

additionalTopics.evidenceScope: Enterprise software licenses and third-party AI contracts
